items.title: JVM Diagnostics & Troubleshooting in Production
items.description: A practical guide to JVM monitoring and diagnostics — jcmd, jstack, jmap, jstat, JFR, async-profiler, heap dump analysis, GC tuning, off-heap leaks, and a field-tested runbook for CPU spikes, deadlocks, and OOM errors.
